rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: A Presidency media advisory says the swearing-in of the new President will follow Parliament's election of a President in Cape Town on 25 September 2008, and schedules the ceremony for 14h30 at Tuynhuys, Cape Town.
